name: Terra Preta
source:
In the early 21st century, industrial modern agriculture destroyed the Earth's soil, triggering a water shortage and a global food crisis. Collapse is imminent within six months. Billions of lives are at risk of starvation.

The Terra Preta Project is our last-ditch effort to create the super-soil that will save humanity. 

But time is running out.

[From [url=https://plainsightdev.itch.io/terra-preta]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
21世纪初，工业化现代农业破坏了地球土壤，引发水资源短缺和全球粮食危机。六个月内崩溃迫在眉睫。数十亿人面临饥饿的危险。

Terra Preta项目是我们为创造拯救人类的超级土壤所做的最后努力。

但时间已经不多了。

[来自[url=https://plainsightdev.itch.io/terra-preta]Itch.io[/url]]
